notes.title: Tamerlane 6.2 Update
notes.notes:
Content of the update:

 Abilities.
 Items.
 Base attacks reworked. 
 Rogue-Lite mode reworked.
 In-Game list of all build components.
 User interface reworked.
 Key binding redone.
 Game balancing and bugs fixed.
 Graphical adjustments.


Steam Achievements and Steam Deck compatibility will follow over the next couple weeks.
